office: the Passport Office of the Government of Nauru, under the Passports Act 2011

routes.label: replacing a first passport lost, stolen or damaged within 10 years of its issue

note: The Passports Regulations 2011 as consolidated on RONLAW, Nauru's online legal database (Service 3, printed 13 November 2024), Schedule 3 Part 1 as substituted by the Passport (Amendment) Regulations 2017 (SL 32, in force 6 December 2017): an ordinary passport's application fee $60; replacing a first passport lost, stolen or damaged within 10 years of its issue $160; an ordinary passport processed within 24 hours $160, including the passport's fee; replacing more than one lost passport within 10 years $560 (not modelled); postage by ordinary mail $100 (not modelled). The fees are in dollars, read as the Australian dollar, Nauru's currency (the Regulations write "Fee ($)"; the 2025 Regulations for economic citizens, which set USD 500 for their passports, say "(USD)" where they mean it, and do not apply to an ordinary citizen). Regulation 5 sets the passport's maximum validity at 10 years (subject to exceptions); as a maximum, it isn't written as the term. No age bands and no standard time are given. The table of amendments lists no change to Schedule 3 after 2017 (the 2021 and 2023 Acts amended other parts).
